_note: Wikipedia article for each pre-1973 Mayhew law (mayhew-1947-1972.json, kind law) that has one, so the Laws signed card on president pages can link it. Entries that are also Timeline landmarks take their link from timeline-events.json 'wiki' and are not listed. 'wiki' is the article title after redirects (checked against the MediaWiki API in pnpm validate); a redirect to a section, a disambiguation page or a different bill is not accepted, so those entries sit in 'unlinked' with the reason. Picks were reviewed by hand against Mayhew's title, year and summary.
